title: Claude Statusline Powerline Configuration
description:
Complete configuration for the statusline
This is the main configuration interface that combines all settings

ColorTheme.description:
Available color themes
- `dark`: Dark theme with muted colors
- `electric`: High-contrast electric colors
- `night-owl`: Night Owl inspired color scheme

LastMessageTimeOptions.description: Options specific to the last_message_time segment

cache_warn_minutes.description: Minutes since last API call before the segment turns red (cache cold). Default: 5

color_cold_bg.description: Background color when cache is cold (default: "#dc2626")

color_cold_fg.description: Foreground color when cache is cold — hex or "auto" (default: "auto")

color_warm_fg.description: Foreground color when cache is warm — hex or "terminal" (default: "terminal")

LineSegments.description:
Defines which segments appear on a specific line
Segments are optional (can be omitted from a line)

SegmentConfig.description: Configuration for a single segment with advanced options

last_message_time_options.description: Options specific to the last_message_time segment (only used when type is "last_message_time")

window_options.description: Options specific to the window segment (only used when type is "window")

minimum_width.description: Minimum width - content will be padded with spaces if shorter

separator.description:
Separator styling. Either a bare style name (shorthand for
`{ style: "<name>" }`) or an object with `style` and/or `color`.

SegmentType.description:
Types of segments that can be displayed in the statusline
- `model`: Shows current AI model information
- `directory`: Shows current directory/path
- `git`: Shows git repository status
- `session`: Shows session usage/cost information
- `context`: Shows cache hit rate and context usage
- `usage`: Shows usage statistics from SQLite database
- `window`: Shows context window usage as % of model's context window

SegmentsConfiguration.description:
Advanced segment configuration system
Allows fine-grained control over segment appearance and behavior

lines.description: Multi-line configuration - which segments appear on each line

SeparatorConfig.description:
Configuration for separator styles across all segments
Defines which separator style to use for each segment type and git state

context.description: Separator style for the context segment

directory.description: Separator style for the directory segment

git.description: Separator styles for different git states

last_message_time.description: Separator style for the last_message_time segment (used only when cache is cold)

model.description: Separator style for the model segment

rate_limits.description: Separator style for the rate_limits segment

session.description: Separator style for the session segment

session_id.description: Separator style for the session_id segment

usage.description: Separator style for the usage segment

window.description: Separator style for the window segment (used only in warn/danger color states)

SeparatorOverride.description: Separator styling override for a segment, in object form.

SeparatorStyle.description: Visual style of powerline separators between segments

WindowSegmentOptions.description: Options specific to the window segment

color_danger_fg.description: Foreground color in danger state — hex or "auto" to derive from background (default: "auto")

color_normal_fg.description: Foreground color in normal (transparent) state — hex or "terminal" for terminal default (default: "terminal")

color_warn_fg.description: Foreground color in warn state — hex or "auto" to derive from background (default: "auto")

show_percent.description: Show percentage of context window used (default: true)

show_tokens.description: Show consumed/total token counts e.g. "42k / 200k" (default: false)

threshold_warn.description: % threshold for amber/warning color (default: 51 = 60% of the 85% auto-compact point)

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for IntelliSense support

color_theme.description: Color theme for segment backgrounds and text

current_theme.description: Internal property populated with actual theme object - not for user configuration

segment_config.description: Advanced segment configuration with multiline layout, styling, and granular control

separators.description: Configure separator styles for different segments and states
